name: FillGrid
h1a: Fill PDF forms like a spreadsheet,
lead: Type straight into the boxes of any PDF form, add seals and signatures, and export. In the same app, decorate a yearly diary with stickers — or just tell an AI about your day.
heroNote: Windows 10 · 11 · Free to use, Pro only when you need it (one-time purchase)
diaryH: A whole year of diary, decorated on your PC
diaryP: Create monthly, weekly, daily-journal and planner pages as new notes, then decorate them with handwriting fonts, stickers, photos and washi tape. Every page below is a real sample made in the app.
persona: Jieun (26) — living on her own, three years into an IT job. Somewhere between hustle and lazy days, she keeps one small joy a day.
capJournal: Daily journal — photo strip · receipt · today's playlist
capFood: What you ate becomes a memory
capWeekly: Weekly — a box a day · mood · habits
capSunset: A scene that stayed with you
capPlanner: Planner — to-dos · habit tracker · weekly review · rewards
formsH: Stop rebuilding PDF forms you received
formsP: Click a box right where it is and type. Move with arrows, Tab and Enter like a spreadsheet, and edit existing text keeping its font and spacing.
capFill: Drag to fill 1, 2, 3… · see the sum instantly
capSign: Add the date and signature, then export a PDF
f4s: Reorder · delete · insert pages from other PDFs
f5s: Turns pictures of text into real text
aiH: Say "write today's journal" — it lands in your note
aiP: Connect FillGrid to the Claude or ChatGPT desktop app, and the day you talk about is written onto your diary page with date, mood and stickers.
aiS1: Download, install and sign in to the Claude or ChatGPT desktop app on your PC.
aiS2: In FillGrid, click the 🤖 button at the top (Connect to AI apps) and press [Connect] next to that app.
aiS3: Restart that app and tell it about your day in a new chat.
phoneP: Link the desktop app to your phone in remote mode, and what you say into the phone's mic is written into your notes on the PC (keep the PC on).
phoneC: Claude — type /rc in Claude on the PC to link your phone
phoneG: ChatGPT — Settings › Connections › add your phone under 'Devices that can control this PC'
plansP: Try every Pro feature free for 14 days after installing. Free features stay free when the trial ends.
fr1: Fill boxes · edit original text · formulas · fill series
fr2: Signatures · office stamps · tables · shapes · icons
fr3: Page editing · find & replace · pens · highlighter
fr4: 10 new-note templates · save · print · PDF export
proP: One-time in-app purchase · not a subscription
pr1: Aesthetic diary & planner templates · sticker packs
pr2: Korean seals · world seals · equations · OCR
pr3: Brush · calligraphy · shape pens · memo pad
trustH: Your documents never leave your PC
trustP: The original PDF stays untouched; your edits are saved separately. No personal data is collected.
